episodes.title: Star of "Trust Me: False Prophet" reacts to 24-year additional sentencing of Samuel Bateman
episodes.description:
Dr. Christine Marie helped document the rise and fall of polygamous sect leader Samuel Bateman in the Netflix series: "Trust Me: False Prophet" She says his latest prison sentence brings relief to survivors — but believes some followers remain under his influence.

An Arizona judge sentenced Bateman to 24 years in prison this week after a jury convicted him of three counts of child abuse. The sentence will run after his existing 50-year federal sentence.
